label: MySQL
description: A store kept in one MySQL database, 8.0.16 or later, for the trees that already have a MySQL. The URL is a secret, since it carries the credentials, and it names the database: a MySQL database is the schema, so there is no schema setting. The pool is a fact about this one database, so it sits here rather than in the plugin's settings. MySQL commits around every DDL statement, so what ensure makes is made step by step.

url.description: the connection URL, read as {{secrets.*}} -- mysql://user:password@host:port/database

pool.description: how many sessions this tree may hold open at once. Absent: ten
